description: Na₈Mg(NiO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.66 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.57 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NiO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.64 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.66 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one NiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.52 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.47 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.41 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.40 Å. Mg is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.11 Å. There are two inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.95 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to four O atoms to form NiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with five NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-1.93 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ni atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ni atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₅Ni octahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ni atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₅Ni octahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ni atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom.
